name: Igenchat
author: rajaigenchat

sections.description:
Igenchat WordPress plugin allows you to easily integrate your Igenchat chatbot into your WordPress website. Simply install the plugin, enter your Chatbot ID, and the chatbot will appear on your site.

This plugin utilizes Igenchat services to deploy a pre-trained chatbot on your website, leveraging the data you’ve uploaded to the Igenchat application.

For more information on privacy, and terms of service, please refer to our dedicated sections on these topics.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/igenchat directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the Settings -> Igenchat Options screen to configure the plugin.
  4. Enter your Chatbot ID from your Igenchat dashboard.
sections.faq:
Where do I find my Chatbot ID?

You can find your Chatbot ID in your Igenchat dashboard under the chatbot settings tab.
